main_text.p: bus à prejudicatis opinioni-bus vacuum pectus, & justam judicum facite decuriam: Vobis judicibus pedum iis extorquebo de manibus, intensum ad viam indicem, cæteris digitis æquabo & flectam in pugnum, infidiosam dexteram usque & usque aventem inseri axillæ, religabo post tergum: Ducis illa insignia, Ducis hæc munia: soli debentur Rationi, soli vindicabo Rationi: Sic adversariis, antequam jure cum iis experimur, insultamus, sic caussæ confidimus & judici: Habeant sibi sanè ad iniqua Vanitatis, Superstitionis, Infscitię tribunalia, gratiosos pa-tro-

page.notes: Left margin shows cropped text from the facing page, not transcribed. The word "Infscitię" is printed as shown, with the line-end "Infscitię" split across "In-" and "scitię"; "tribunalia" follows the printed form.
